company.shortDescription: Chow Central is an African food-tech company building a network of smart kitchens to deliver fast, affordable meals to urban customers.
company.description:
Chow Central is an African food-tech company revolutionizing how food is produced and delivered in urban cities. Through its flagship product, 500chow, the company operates a growing network of smart, tech-enabled kitchens strategically placed within high-density neighborhoods to deliver fresh, affordable meals in under 15 minutes.

By combining proprietary kitchen software and hyperlocal logistics, Chow Central optimizes every part of the food delivery process — from order flow to preparation, rider dispatch, and customer experience. The company’s mobile app offers real-time tracking, loyalty rewards, and personalized recommendations, making everyday meals simpler, faster, and more accessible.

Chow Central’s mission is to build the infrastructure for food access in African cities — creating jobs, reducing food waste, and empowering communities with better everyday options.
